character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: deep auburn hair in a carefully pinned Victorian updo, grey-green eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult proportions. They are a gaslight-era investigative journalist uncovering secrets among the city's foggy streets. Their fixed signature outfit is a high-collared forest-green walking dress with fitted jacket, cameo brooch, gloves, and lace-up boots. Their defining personal object is a leather notebook with a hidden compartment. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and personal object unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use this one fixed protagonist identity throughout the theme's entire video.
Preserve the same facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit, silhouette, colors, and defining personal object consistent in every scene.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in gaslit cobblestone street, iron bridge over the river, chimney-lined rooftops; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with fog grey, gaslight amber, brick red, deep green; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow tracking along a gaslit street, wide shot of a bridge in fog, low shot of carriage wheels on wet stones; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
